page.overview:
Who is Kanpō?

He wears the standard high-collared, full body uniform of the Konoha medical ninja. His uniform has also the Medic Corps sign on the left side of his chest.

As a medical-nin, Kanpō presumably has a high level of intellect, is well-versed in medical ninjutsu, and has excellent chakra control to perform medical procedures.

He attended to Neji Hyūga after his match with Naruto Uzumaki in the final part of the Chūnin Exams. He was surprised when Hiashi Hyūga showed up to speak with Neji, and exited the room leaving the two alone at his request.
